title: ASK UNK — Focused Card Viewer
summary: Drag the Lamine Yamal card through a 498×498 studio stage to turn it naturally, catch the light, and reveal its back.

blocks.content:
This experiment pulls the card presentation out of the ASK UNK detail screen and removes the surrounding product interface.

The result is intentionally simple: one card, one dark stage, and no visible controls.
Drag in any direction to rotate the physical card. Orbit damping, idle motion, card depth, and a moving studio shine reproduce the ASK UNK interaction.
